from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re
import klayout.db as db
c=Path('hw/soc/out/external-review-20260919/route-closure-20260923');p=c/'sram-bitcell-width-witness/bitcell.gds'
cdl=c/'sram-bitcell-width-witness/bitcell.cdl'
inputs={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in (p,cdl)}
widths=[float(x) for x in re.findall(r'\blvsres w=([^ ]+)',cdl.read_text())]
assert len(widths)==6 and all(abs(w-0.26e-6)<1e-15 for w in widths)
l=db.Layout();l.read(str(p));cell=l.cell('RM_IHPSG13_2P_BITKIT_CELL');rows=[]
for layer,name in [(10,'Metal2'),(30,'Metal3')]:
 # Determine the existing marker datatype from the witness layer inventory.
 for idx in l.layer_indexes():
  inf=l.get_info(idx)
  if inf.layer==layer:print('Layer',inf.to_s(),'shapes',cell.shapes(idx).size())
for layer,name in [(10,'Metal2'),(30,'Metal3')]:
 metal=db.Region(cell.begin_shapes_rec(l.layer(layer,0))).merged()
 marks=db.Region(cell.begin_shapes_rec(l.layer(layer,29))).merged()
 for poly in marks.each():
  box=poly.bbox();is_vertical=box.height()>box.width()
  delta=round((0.26/l.dbu-(box.width() if is_vertical else box.height()))/2)
  expanded=db.Box(box.left-delta if is_vertical else box.left,box.bottom if is_vertical else box.bottom-delta,box.right+delta if is_vertical else box.right,box.top if is_vertical else box.top+delta)
  missing=db.Region(expanded)-metal
  rows.append(dict(metal=name,marker_bbox=box.to_s(),proposed_annotation_bbox=expanded.to_s(),original_drawing_covers_vendor_cdl_width=missing.is_empty(),uncovered_area_um2=missing.area()*l.dbu*l.dbu))
result=dict(scope='Read-only feasibility of annotation-only correction to independent original CDL width; no geometry or reference changes and no LVS acceptance',rows=rows)
assert len(rows)==6
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest for name,digest in inputs.items())
result['input_sha256']=inputs
result['verbatim_reference_widths_m']=widths
result['script_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(c/'sram-marker-enclosure.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
